restatements.text: Prohibits demonstrating within 100 feet of the entrance to a house of worship while scheduled religious services are taking place.

findings.quote: No person may demonstrate within 100 feet of the entrance of a house of worship during scheduled religious services.
findings.mechanism: It restricts freedom of speech and assembly by creating a spatial and temporal buffer zone where demonstrations are banned.

findings.quote: No person may demonstrate within 100 feet of the entrance of a house of worship during scheduled religious services.
findings.mechanism: It protects religious exercise by shielding attendees from disruption, noise, or confrontation as they enter or attend scheduled services.

analysis.answer: Current law permits demonstrations on public sidewalks subject only to general noise and traffic rules. The measure changes this by adding a specific restriction that bans demonstrations within 100 feet of a house of worship's entrance during scheduled services.
Demonstrators bear the cost of losing access to a specific public space during service times. Congregants and religious organizations benefit from a guaranteed buffer zone free of protest activity.

Demonstrators will likely adjust by holding protests outside the 100-foot radius or at times when services are not scheduled. Police will be required to measure boundaries and assess whether specific activities violate the new restriction.

The text addresses the problem of protests disrupting religious services or impeding access for attendees. The 100-foot buffer mechanism addresses this by enforcing physical separation between demonstrators and congregants during service times.
Law enforcement officers gain discretion to determine what conduct qualifies as a demonstration and to enforce the 100-foot boundary around house of worship entrances.

flags.note: The term is not defined, leaving it to law enforcement to decide what activities (such as praying silently, holding signs, or distributing literature) qualify as a demonstration.

items.text: Protection for attendees of religious services from nearby protests and disruptions.
The ability to demonstrate in public areas within 100 feet of a house of worship during scheduled services.

changes.empty_reason: The measure does not affect any directional concerns.

items.text: The ability to demonstrate on public sidewalks near houses of worship, subject only to general noise and traffic laws.
A 100-foot protest-free buffer zone around entrances to houses of worship during scheduled services.
